    candidates.append(Path.cwd())

def find_artifact(name):
    bases = []
    for base in (ROOT, Path.cwd()):

class Image:
    def __init__(self, width, height, background):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.pixels = bytearray(bytes(background) * (width * height))
    def set(self, x, y, color):
        if 0 <= x < self.width and 0 <= y < self.height:
            i = (y * self.width + x) * 3
            self.pixels[i] = color[0]
            self.pixels[i + 1] = color[1]
            self.pixels[i + 2] = color[2]
    def hline(self, x0, x1, y, color):
        if x0 > x1:
            x0, x1 = x1, x0
        for x in range(max(0, x0), min(self.width, x1 + 1)):
            self.set(x, y, color)
    def vline(self, x, y0, y1, color):
        if y0 > y1:
            y0, y1 = y1, y0
        for y in range(max(0, y0), min(self.height, y1 + 1)):
            self.set(x, y, color)
    def rect(self, x0, y0, x1, y1, color):
        if x0 > x1: x0,x1=x1,x0
        if y0 > y1: y0,y1=y1,y0
        start_y = max(0, y0)
        end_y = min(self.height, y1 + 1)
        start_x = max(0, x0)
        end_x = min(self.width, x1 + 1)
        for y in range(start_y, end_y):
            base = y * self.width * 3
            for x in range(start_x, end_x):
                i = base + x * 3
                self.pixels[i] = color[0]
                self.pixels[i + 1] = color[1]
                self.pixels[i + 2] = color[2]

def write_png(path, image):
    def chunk(tag, data):
        return struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + tag + data + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    raw = bytearray()
    for y in range(image.height):
        raw.append(0)
        raw.extend(image.pixels[y * image.width * 3:(y + 1) * image.width * 3])
    ihdr = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", image.width, image.height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)
    payload = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    payload += chunk(b"IHDR", ihdr)
    payload += chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(bytes(raw), 9))
    payload += chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    path.write_bytes(payload)

    blue = (35, 105, 185)
    black = (25, 25, 25)

    img.rect(x0, y0, x1, y1, white)

    max_count = max(counts) if counts and max(counts) > 0 else 1
    n = len(counts) if counts else 1
    bin_width = (x1 - x0) / float(n)
    for i, count in enumerate(counts):
